message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFKD) and strips the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`: its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit it by hand.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accented letters. I left that alone because it's outside this task. If you want it fixed too, the same normalization would go in that file.

I didn't commit anything.
